items.quote: Damit wir die neue Miete berücksichtigen können, reichen Sie bitte bis zum 14.07.2026 den unterschriebenen Mietvertrag und den Nachweis über die Kaution ein.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for this submission: 14.07.2026. No period calculation is needed; this is the last day the signed Mietvertrag and the Kautionsnachweis must reach the Jobcenter so the new rent can be considered from August 2026.

items.title: File Widerspruch against the Bescheid
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe beim Jobcenter Musterhavel-Fläming, Fläminger Weg 4, 14943 Beispielsruh (Havel), eingehen.
items.computation: Letter is dated Tue 30.06.2026 and is sent by ordinary post. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X it counts as given (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: Sat 04.07.2026 — for this social-law deemed-delivery rule that day does not shift even though it falls on a Saturday. Counting of the one-month Widerspruchsfrist then starts the next day under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X, i.e. from 04.07.2026, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the month ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number: Tue 04.08.2026. That day is itself a working day in Brandenburg, so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X applies. The Widerspruch must reach the Jobcenter by this date (to arrive, not merely be posted by then).
